title: 第25章 花耶离婚了第26章 做什么爱做的事
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
很快，一路跟着花耶来到了上城区。
而即便是到了现在，花耶都是懵懵地有些不太敢相信，但是仔仔细细比对了上面的照片和林恩的样貌之后，她也才敢确信，他居然也是他们学院的学生。
但是一想起昨天晚上他变异成的那种可怕的怪物的模样，她又不由得有些哆嗦。
“所……所以你其实是占据了一个我们学院一个学生的身体才降临的吗？”
花耶有些害怕地问道。
林恩望着自己的学生证，思索道：
“当然了啊，不过在我降临到他身体的时候，他就已经死了……但既然是你们学校的人，那说不定应该可以从这里着手，进一步地补全我的个人信息。”
没错，先一点点地熟悉他的人际关系。
然后再建立自己的社交网络。
娶媳妇。
嫖。
然后以此慢慢地混入正常的人类社会。
而只要一想到能够重新做人，他全身的触手都忍不住地蠢蠢欲动了。
呃呵呵呵——
【叮！你的快乐+1】
他的手腕上瞬间就爆出了一根可可爱爱的小触手。
花耶：“哇呀呀呀（ΩДΩ）？！”
花耶一把就把它给像抓棍棍一样抓住了。
“不要随便在大街上就暴乱啊，你不是要当人吗？！这样真的会很危险！很危险的啊！”
“sorry，情不自禁。”

“……”
花耶颤抖地拍了拍并不存在的胸脯，咕咚地吞咽了一声。
完了。
她看到那触手第一想到的居然不是害怕。
而是担心他会不会暴露了。
难道说仅仅相处了一个晚上的时间，花耶就已经有了崩坏恶堕的觉悟了吗？
她已经开始把自己当成怪物的小媳妇了吗？
呜呜，不要啊！
好猎奇呀o（╥﹏╥）o
“你……你确定要去那边？”
花耶下意识抓紧了一下林恩的手腕，（o﹏o?）道：
“可你要是走了的话，花耶怎么办呀！要是在突然出现什么可怕的东西，花耶就没有人保护了！那个悬赏令可是还在的！”
林恩一瞥她，道：
“都一个学校，你怕什么怕？”
花耶顿时o（≧口≦）o道：“哪……哪里是呀！花耶是在贵族区！你是在平民区！中间可是隔着很远很远的一段距离呢！！而且……而且……花耶都已经卖给你当小媳妇了！你不可以不管我！！”
content_en:
Soon, I followed Hua Ye all the way to Shangcheng District.
Even now, Hua Ye is still confused and can't believe it, but after carefully comparing the photo above with Lin En's appearance, she is convinced that he is actually a student of their college.
But when she thought of the terrifying monster he mutated into last night, she couldn't help but tremble.
"So...so you actually came here by occupying the body of a student in our college?"
Huaye asked with some fear.
Lin En looked at his student ID card and thought:
"Of course, but when I came to his body, he was already dead... But since he is from your school, maybe I can start from here to further complete my personal information."
That's right, get familiar with his interpersonal relationships a little bit first.
Then build your own social network.
Take a wife.
visit a prostitute.
Then slowly blend into normal human society.
And as soon as he thought about being able to be a new person, the tentacles all over his body couldn't help but move.
Uh hehehe——
[Ding! Your happiness +1]
A cute little tentacle burst out from his wrist in an instant.
Hua Ye: "Wow yeah yeah (ΩДΩ)?!"
Huaye grabbed it like a stick.
"Don't just riot on the street. Don't you want to be human?! This will be really dangerous! It's very dangerous!"
"Sorry, I couldn't help myself."
"..."
Huaye tremblingly patted her non-existent chest and swallowed loudly.
It's over.
The first thing that came to her mind when she saw the tentacles was actually not fear.
But I was worried that he would be exposed.
Could it be said that after just one night together, Hua Ye already had the consciousness of collapse and evil?
Has she already begun to regard herself as the monster's little wife?
Woo hoo, no!
So curious o（╥﹏╥）o
"Are you...are you sure you want to go there?"
Hua Ye subconsciously grabbed Lin En's wrist and said (o﹏o?):
"But if you leave, what will Hua Ye do? If something terrible suddenly appears, Hua Ye will have no one to protect her! The reward order is still there!"
Lin En glanced at her and said:
"We are all in the same school, what are you afraid of?"
Hua Ye suddenly said: "Where...where is it! Hua Ye is in the aristocratic area! You are in the civilian area! There is a long, long distance in between!! And... and... Hua Ye has been sold to you as your little wife! You can't ignore me!!"
